channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: EU proposal targets crypto networks in 22nd Russia sanctions round
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would add transaction restrictions on 60 banks and target crypto networks, but all 27 EU states must approve it.

item.title: Why Is My Vault Withdrawal Pending in MetaMask?
item.description: Vault withdrawal transactions stuck pending in MetaMask are usually waiting on a higher fee or an earlier nonce. Speed up or replace the blocking transaction.

item.title: Base L1 and L2 bridge addresses: the official list
item.description: The Base L1 and L2 bridge contract addresses are on Base’s official contracts page: Ethereum’s L1StandardBridge and portal, plus Base’s L2 predeploys.

item.title: TeleSwap vs THORChain: Swap Native Bitcoin for ETH or teleBTC
item.description: TeleSwap suits a Bitcoin holder who wants BTC exposure as teleBTC on a supported EVM chain; THORChain suits one who wants native ETH out. For the bridge…

item.title: Berachain bridge tokens missing: delivery may be complete
item.description: Berachain bridge tokens not showing in wallet? They usually arrived; check Berascan, then switch to Berachain, import the token, or refresh your RPC.

item.title: How to Choose an Operator for Restaking With a Clear Risk Checklist
item.description: How to choose an operator for restaking: compare AVS duties, stake allocations, security evidence and fees before delegating ETH or liquid staking tokens.

item.title: What Does a Good Rugcheck Result Look Like? A Clean Report
item.description: A good rugcheck result shows revoked mint and freeze authority, mostly burned or locked liquidity, dispersed holders, and no danger-level risk items in the report.

item.title: TWAP order vs limit order: choose between exit and price
item.description: TWAP order vs limit order for selling a large token position: use TWAP when a full exit matters; choose a limit order when your minimum price matters more.

item.title: EU proposal targets Russian crypto rails and 60 banks
item.description: The European Commission has proposed adding crypto and payment networks to Russia sanctions, alongside 60 banks and restrictions on Russian participation in EU sport.

item.title: Aave App opens to the public after early access tops $63 million
item.description: Aave Labs opened its savings app to the public after early access balances passed $63 million, with deposits routed into Aave lending markets to earn borrower interest.

item.title: What Is Gwei? Read Your Wallet’s Gas Cost
item.description: What is gwei in simple terms? It is a tiny unit for quoting gas prices; multiply the price by gas used to work out the fee in the chain’s native coin.

item.title: Liquidity Pool and Lock-and-Mint Bitcoin Bridges
item.description: Liquidity pool bridge vs lock and mint bridge for Bitcoin: choose a pool for native coins, or lock and mint for BTC exposure on an EVM chain.

item.title: Gas Limit vs Gas Price When a Bridge Deposit Is Pending
item.description: Gas limit vs gas price: raise both fee fields to speed a pending deposit; raise the limit only after an out-of-gas failure, which still costs gas.

item.title: Bitcoin’s $55,000 dip puts 11.6 million BTC in loss
item.description: Bitcoin’s weekend slide to about $55,000 pushed more than 11.6 million BTC below their last-move price, while supply in profit fell beneath its FTX-era low.

item.title: How do I check Solana token account delegates?
item.description: To check token approvals on a Solana wallet, inspect each SPL token account’s delegate and delegated amount on Solscan or with spl-token, then revoke unwanted delegates.

item.title: What Does eth_subscribe Stream Over Ethereum WebSocket RPC?
item.description: What is eth_subscribe in Ethereum WebSocket RPC? It opens a persistent connection that pushes live chain events, while leaving reconnection and missed-event recovery to you.

item.title: Is the Sui Bridge safe when your balance is missing?
item.description: Is the Sui bridge safe? Suibridge is reasonably safe for normal use, but validator trust, contract bugs, phishing and wrong addresses still put funds at risk.

item.title: How to check token liquidity before swapping on a DEX
item.description: Learn how to check token liquidity before swapping on a DEX by comparing pool reserves with your trade and checking the quote’s output and price impact.

item.title: How do I tell whether a zkSync Era token is fake?
item.description: How to spot a fake token on zkSync Era: match its contract address to the issuer’s published address, then inspect the contract and holders on the explorer.

item.title: Hong Kong bill targets four crypto service lines
item.description: A Hong Kong bill would extend SFC licensing to crypto dealing, advice, portfolio management and custody, setting a new compliance perimeter for service firms.
